closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, vitamin K, and omega 3, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low protein quality, and taste can be polarising. It is good for immune support, low-calorie volume, and digestion because vitamin C and vitamin A gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure, and the pros add a digestion or tolerance angle.
